fix_commit_message:
[maglev types] Fix write barriers in dead code - again

This CL inserts an early bailout if the value type is empty, so that we
don't end up with contradictions about whether or not a write barrier is
needed.

Fixed: 414840455
Change-Id: I35b60a74467123088c43a8db623768442917eb55
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6507788

Commit-Queue: Marja Hölttä <marja@chromium.org>

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix afb07f082328 on top of intro 7556d7f16c6c via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The Maglev type-system refactoring (commit 7556d7f) introduced empty node types as a sentinel for dead/unreachable code and changed `NodeTypeIs` so that the empty type is a subset of every type (0 & ~X == 0 for all X). This means empty-typed values pass type-compatibility tests silently. `TryBuildStoreField` lacked an early exit for empty-typed accumulator values, so the double-field code path could proceed with a logically impossible value and produce type contradictions in downstream write-barrier analysis.
